criticism: The function 'mintTokens' is vulnerable to integer overflow. It does not validate the input to ensure it is not greater than the maximum value that can be stored by the token's supply variable, which can lead to an overflow when attempting to mint more tokens than the contract can handle. The function should use safe math operations to prevent such vulnerabilities.

The function 'burnTokens' is vulnerable to integer overflow. It does not validate the input to ensure it is not greater than the balance of the sender, which can lead to an overflow when attempting to burn more tokens than the user has. The function should use safe math operations to prevent such vulnerabilities and consider the implications of such an overflow on the contract's state.
